approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-122 says a rebased and re-approved delta materializes keeping the other change's text it now carries; a body rebased before the other change landed could not be re-approved without a byte edit. Leif chose the three-way fix on 2026-11-10
acceptance_criteria: re-approving an unchanged MODIFIED or REMOVED delta whose canonical block moved since approval succeeds and records the new base when the approval-time base text, recovered from git by its recorded digest, shows in a line-level three-way comparison that the body already carries every edit the current text made; otherwise, including when the base cannot be recovered, it is refused as before and nothing is recorded; no new flags

answers.constraints: CHANGE-11: an approved change never silently overwrites newer text; an unrecoverable base or any uncarried edit keeps the refusal
